entities.summary: Yannick Mertens is a professional former tennis player from Belgium who mainly has played on the ATP Challenger Tour. On 27 July 2015, he reached his highest ATP singles ranking of world No. 179, and his highest doubles ranking of No. 363 was reached on 19 September 2011.
